title: Cardamom Saffron Rasmalai Milk Cake
hookLine: Pillowy sponge soaked in fragrant saffron-cardamom milk and crowned with crushed pistachios.

steps.title: Preheat Oven & Prep Your Pan
steps.instructionTemplate: Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C) and line your baking pan with parchment paper, leaving a slight overhang for effortless lifting. Measure out {milk_rm} and {saff_rm} so everything is ready and at room temperature for a silky, lump-free batter.

steps.title: Bake Tender Cardamom Sponge
steps.instructionTemplate: Bake {sponge_rm} at 350°F (175°C) for 20 minutes until golden and springy. Line your baking pan with parchment paper or grease lightly, and make sure {sponge_rm} are measured and at room temperature so they blend smoothly.

steps.title: Steep Saffron Milk & Pour Over Cake
steps.instructionTemplate: Warm {milk_rm} with {saff_rm} for 5 mins, poke holes in the warm sponge, pour saffron milk over, chill 2 hours, and garnish with whipped cream & {pist_rm}.
steps.creatorSecret: Soak saffron in 2 tbsp warm milk first to unlock maximum golden color and aroma.

steps.title: Cool Completely, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Transfer Cardamom Saffron Rasmalai Milk Cake to a wire cooling rack and let it cool for 15–20 minutes so the interior sets cleanly without crumbling. Lift out using the parchment overhang, garnish as desired, and slice into 8 portions.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 35 mins.
